title: Grothendieck module categories at the coefficient universe
statement:
Let C be essentially small in universe w, J a topology with the stated abelian sheafification and ring-compose hypotheses, and R a sheaf of rings valued in universe w. Then the category of sheaves of R-modules valued in w is Grothendieck abelian in universe w, without imposing an additional inequality between w and the original presentation universes of C.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
theorem isGrothendieckAbelian_coefficientUniverse
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    (S : Sheaf J RingCat.{w}) : IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} (SheafOfModules.{w} S)
```

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, ordinary evaluation left extension and the subsequence generalization; Stacks 03DA, 03DB, 06YT and 07D9

proof.text: Use the small model of C to index a small family of free sheaf-module generators. The existing free-module generating property detects maps after transfer through the small-model equivalence. Filtered colimits are exact because the exact conservative forgetful functor to abelian sheaves creates them. Package AB5 and the small generator family to obtain the Grothendieck property.
